name: Alsónémedi (Hungary)
description: White field with a yellow border, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Alsónémedi: a blue shield with a yellow sheaf of grain, within a yellow frame inscribed ALSÓNÉMEDI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Alsónémedi arms in a yellow frame
